title: 第5章 陈晓云的心里疙瘩第6章 陈晓云教姬云生识字
content_zh:
陈晓云一听明白了，温柔笑着说道：“爹爹，没有关系的，就算弟弟测试后，哪怕也没有天赋，我也会护着弟弟的。不过想来弟弟天赋很高，万一真是天级之上的天赋呢？毕竟云荒山如此危险之地，恐怕弟弟被丢弃，也是有什么隐情呢？”
陈明笑了笑说道：“晓云，或许吧，不过要真是如此的话，你以后就算去报仇的话，也能轻松很多了。我也挺希望云生或许真是天级之上的天赋，只是至于是什么还要等测试之后才知道了。”陈晓云笑着温柔回答道：“爹爹，我相信弟弟不会让我们失望的，
就算弟弟的天赋没有在天级之上的天赋，以我天级天赋，我也能亲自报仇的，只是需要的时间会多了很多而已。”姬云生喝着兽奶，心里那个着急啊！喃喃道：“我也是醉了，你们就不能把话说完吗？天级之上的天赋是什么，倒是说下啊！我也能好好了解下，
还有就是，你们心也太大了，我自己都不相信我能有修炼天赋。万一真是天崩开局，测试出来是个废材的话，那岂不是尴尬的一批了。毕竟我虽然是穿越者，但看了那么多小说，我既没有金手指等之类的东西，我可是比你们还要慌的。
虽然穿越是一件好事，能够修仙了，但修仙那讲究的是天赋，要是没有天赋，在这么危险的世界，我可是非常慌得一批。”陈明一听想了想，笑着说道：“好了，晓云，你还是赶紧尝尝爹爹，给你准备的饭菜！你弟弟如此乖巧，你就先把他放在你婴儿时的小床上吧。”
陈晓云一听，也抱着姬云生起身，轻轻的把他放在小床上，温柔笑着说道：“弟弟，你先在这里喝兽奶，等姐姐吃完爹爹做的饭菜后，再来陪你玩。”姬云生一听点点头，也没有放开喝着兽奶的小嘴，陈晓云见状，心里感慨道：“这弟弟还真是乖巧。”
然后又回到自己的座位坐下，等不及的就拿起筷子，品尝起自己爹爹做的饭菜了，刚吃完一口，温柔笑着说道：“爹爹，好好吃，在宗门里的饭菜都不如爹爹做的。”陈明一听笑了笑说道：“晓云，慢点吃，没有人跟你抢，饭菜那么多呢。”
然后也开始动筷吃了起来，陈晓云边吃边说道：“爹爹，怎么会没有跟我抢呢？等弟弟断奶后，这不就有人了。”陈明一听，差点没有噎到自己，缓口气才笑着回答道：“晓云，现在云生是你弟弟，就算他断奶了，你这做姐姐的难道还要和弟弟争抢吗？”
陈晓云一听，边吃边说道：“爹爹，我这不是开玩笑的吗！我做姐姐的怎么会和弟弟争抢呢？毕竟我如今踏入筑基了，就算一个月不吃饭都可以的。要不是被爹爹做的饭菜，搞得太嘴馋改不了这习惯，我才不会如此呢。”姬云生在一旁也是听得无语了，
心里喃喃道：“看来每个女生都是小馋猫，不论在哪个世界都是一样。”陈明一听也是无奈摇摇头，边夹菜给陈晓云，边笑着说道：“晓云，多吃点，不够的话，爹爹在去做就好。”陈晓云见状也是，夹菜给他温柔笑着说道：“爹爹，你也吃，不用如此麻烦的，
还有以后爹爹不能在去云荒山了，就算是在外围也不行，毕竟这里云荒山太危险了，好歹也是苍玄大陆的禁地之一。万一哪天跑出来个妖兽，爹爹要是出事的话，你让女儿今后如何啊？以女儿如今的修为，如今的资源，能让爹爹和弟弟过上不错的日子了。
就算不如那些有名的天骄，也是比凡人中有钱之人过得好多了。”陈明一听也是心里一阵暖意，笑着回答道：“好好好，爹爹以后不去了，我向你保证。晓云如今长大了，你娘亲要是知道该有多好！”陈晓云一听又一阵寒意释放，但很快又消失了，
温柔笑着说道：“爹爹，你能别提她了吗？搞得女儿胃口都没有了。”陈明一听，尴尬笑着说道：“晓云，我知道你肯定很恨你母亲，自你出生后就没有陪着你长大，但我还是希望你不要如此，你娘亲如此做也是为了你好。”陈晓云一听，连忙停下继续品尝吃饭菜的欲望，
收拾了下笑着回答道：“爹爹，我吃饱了，我陪弟弟去了。”陈明见状也是无奈，边吃饭菜边心里喃喃道：“晓云啊！都怪爹爹，要不是因为爹爹，你就不会如此记恨你母亲了。”
content_en:
Chen Xiaoyun understood as soon as he heard it, and said with a gentle smile: "Dad, it doesn't matter. Even if my brother has no talent after the test, I will protect him. But I think my brother is very talented. What if he is really a talent above the heaven level? After all, Yunhuang Mountain is such a dangerous place. I'm afraid there is some hidden reason why my brother was abandoned?"
Chen Ming smiled and said: "Xiaoyun, maybe, but if that's the case, it will be much easier for you to seek revenge in the future. I also hope that Yunsheng may really be a heaven-level talent, but we have to wait until the test to find out what it is." Chen Xiaoyun smiled and replied gently: "Dad, I believe that my brother will not let us down.
Even if my brother's talent is not above the heaven level, with my heaven level talent, I can still take revenge myself, but it will take a lot more time. "Ji Yunsheng drank the beast's milk, feeling anxious in his heart! He murmured: "I'm drunk too, can't you guys finish your sentence? Please tell me what the talent above the heaven level is! I can also understand it well,
Also, you are too ambitious. I myself don’t believe that I can have the talent for cultivation. If the game really starts with a collapse of heaven and the test turns out to be a waste, wouldn't it be an embarrassing batch? After all, although I am a time traveler, I have read so many novels and I don’t have golden fingers or anything like that. I am even more panicked than you are.
Although it is a good thing to travel through time and be able to cultivate immortality, cultivation of immortality requires talent. Without talent, I would be very panicked in such a dangerous world. After hearing this, Chen Ming thought for a while and said with a smile: "Okay, Xiaoyun, you'd better try the food that daddy prepared for you!" Your brother is so well-behaved, so just put him in your little baby bed first. "
Upon hearing this, Chen Xiaoyun also hugged Ji Yunsheng and stood up, gently placed him on the small bed, and said with a gentle smile: "Brother, you drink the animal milk here first, and after my sister has finished eating the food cooked by daddy, I will come and play with you." Ji Yunsheng nodded when he heard this, but did not let go of his mouth drinking the animal milk. When Chen Xiaoyun saw this, he sighed in his heart: "This brother is really well-behaved."
Then he returned to his seat and sat down. He couldn't wait to pick up his chopsticks and taste the food cooked by his father. After finishing a bite, he said with a gentle smile: "Dad, it's delicious. The food in the sect is not as good as the food cooked by my father." Chen Ming smiled when he heard it and said: "Xiaoyun, eat slowly, no one will compete with you, there is so much food."
Then he started to eat with chopsticks. Chen Xiaoyun said while eating: "Dad, why didn't you fight with me? After my brother is weaned, there will be people here." When Chen Ming heard this, he almost choked himself. He took a breath and replied with a smile: "Xiaoyun, Yunsheng is your brother now. Even if he is weaned, do you, as a sister, still have to fight with your brother?"
When Chen Xiaoyun heard this, he said while eating: "Dad, aren't I kidding! How can I, as a sister, compete with my brother? After all, I have entered the foundation building now, and I can go without eating for a month. I wouldn't be like this if I hadn't been so greedy by the food cooked by my father that I couldn't change this habit." Ji Yunsheng was also speechless.
He murmured in his heart: "It seems that every girl is a greedy little cat, no matter what world she is in." Chen Ming shook his head helplessly when he heard this, and while picking up some food for Chen Xiaoyun, he said with a smile: "Xiaoyun, eat more. If it's not enough, daddy will do it." Seeing this, Chen Xiaoyun also picked up the food for him and said with a gentle smile: "Daddy, you can eat too, no need to bother.
In addition, dad can no longer go to Yunhuang Mountain, even in the periphery. After all, Yunhuang Mountain here is too dangerous, and it is also one of the forbidden areas of Cangxuan Continent. What if a monster comes out one day, and if something happens to dad, what do you want your daughter to do in the future? toMy daughter's current cultivation level and current resources can enable her father and younger brother to live a good life.
Even if he is not as good as those famous geniuses, he still lives much better than the rich people among mortals. Chen Ming felt warm in his heart when he heard this, and replied with a smile: "Okay, okay, daddy won't go there anymore, I promise you." Xiaoyun has grown up now, if only your mother knew! "Chen Xiaoyun felt another chill after hearing this, but it quickly disappeared again.
She said with a gentle smile: "Dad, can you stop mentioning her? My daughter has lost her appetite. "When Chen Ming heard this, he smiled awkwardly and said, "Xiaoyun, I know you must hate your mother very much. She has not grown up with you since you were born, but I still hope you won't do this. Your mother did this for your own good. "When Chen Xiaoyun heard this, he quickly stopped trying to taste the food.
After tidying up, he smiled and replied: "Dad, I'm full, I'm going with my brother. Chen Ming was helpless when he saw this. While eating the food, he murmured in his heart: "Xiaoyun!" It's all dad's fault. If it weren't for dad, you wouldn't hate your mother so much. "
